# Marine Calculators

Marine Calculators is a free, browser-based collection of transparent coastal and marine engineering calculation tools. Each calculator exposes its input definitions, outputs, equations, applicability notes and validation status.

Main site: https://dgreer1.github.io/marine_calculators_web/

Core topics include linear and nonlinear regular wave theory, shallow-water wave statistics, shoaling and refraction, Stokes drift, wind and cyclone waves, sediment fall velocity and mobilisation, wave setup and run-up, EurOtop 2018 overtopping, armour rock sizing, and wave transmission.

Important: results are engineering aids. Users must check applicability ranges and project-specific evidence. The Resources page contains a validation register distinguishing reference checks, formula checks and methods still needing independent benchmarks.
